citation.authors: Wright KD, Klatt MD, Adams IR, Nguyen CM et al
citation.journal: Journal of the American Geriatrics Society

record.population: African American older adults with mild cognitive impairment and hypertension (pilot, US community centre)
record.design: Cluster randomised pilot of Mindfulness in Motion plus DASH diet (includes breathing exercises, mindful movement and guided meditation) against attention-only and control groups, 3 months
record.finding: Feasible and culturally acceptable. Systolic blood pressure fell 7.2 mmHg in the intervention group against 0.7 in the attention-only group, but there was no difference from the true control group, and no changes in diet or mindfulness.
record.note: A mixed package, not breathwork alone, and a feasibility pilot. Counts toward 'a trial in African Americans exists' only.
